id: title:Gilbert09:add 1 missing tables to the elasticsearch source

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion of Elasticsearch data streams by preserving backing index and using composite primary keys, potentially enabling recovery and deduplication across backing indices.
review.reason: Adds an `include_index` parameter and composite primary keys (`_index`, `_id`) for Elasticsearch data streams, allowing warehouse ingestion to preserve backing indices. This could support PostHog warehouse ingestion of stream-backed logs and metrics, including recovery and deduplication across backing indices.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on warehouse ingestion implementation and adoption, neither of which is demonstrated in this chunk; the chunk is dominated by documentation and tests, and no production behavior or recovery handling is shown.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and test changes. No score is assigned.
